purpose: Offline structural template for track-shape checks only. This file is not a live-proven standalone trajectory generator. A fresh project needs a project-private accepted track seed or a newly captured accepted seed, then mutates that seed per round.

acceptance.rule: Do not claim live trajectory acceptance from this structural template alone.

generation.eventShape: x,y,timeMs[,flag]  (pipe-separated; click/up events carry a fifth empty field as in mc/mu)
orderingRules: TrackStartTime and TrackList.startTime must be equal and chosen fresh per round
event times are relative ms within 0..999999 and must stay monotonically increasing per field
the last event must not be later than the real Log3/Verify send time
VerifyTime = TrackStartTime + declared duration + settle margin
generate a fresh arg per round (CertifyId-bound 16-char key through the shared VM helper)
load movement events from a project-private accepted seed before perturbing; this template alone is only an offline shape guard
diagnosisOrder: structure is accepted only after sidecar (Log2/Log3 200/true) and full profile/sparse token consistency are aligned
tune trajectory last: first vary counts and pace, then offsets, then screen ratio
